sectors.trend: Miners wobble on ASX but exploration wins in WA/SA gold-copper and Kazakh copper/graphite provide offset. Coal demand resilient; critical minerals (graphite, tin-tungsten) gaining traction.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face near-term pressure from global risk-off. Small/mid-cap explorers (BHG.AX, FRT.AX, PLC.AX, CTA.AX, SRY.AX) benefit from discovery momentum. Coal (WDS.AX, LSE.AX) defying narrative of decline.

sectors.trend: Banks wobble on ASX; mortgage stress and negative equity among young borrowers raise NPL concerns. Bank exits from truck financing signal tightening credit. Fed decision adds uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from RBA rate sensitivity and consumer stress. Monitor NPL trends and credit growth. Fed meeting this week is key catalyst.

sectors.trend: Oil price spike from Houthi seizure of choke point and Iran tensions. Fuel blowout pressures government for excise cut. Australia nearing energy inflection point. TMK Energy gas flows surge in Mongolia.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, AWE.AX, XVG.AX benefit from oil spike. Downstream (WES.AX, BRL.AX) face input cost pressure. LNG exporters (WDS.AX, GSO.AX) supported by supply disruption premium.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator breakup via lender-backed consortium bid signals sector consolidation. Bird flu in endangered sea lions adds biosecurity risk.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, IAG.AX (health insurance) in focus. Hospital operator breakup may create M&A opportunities. Monitor SGH.AX and IAG.AX for consolidation play.

sectors.trend: Inflation squeezing households (Macca's, MacBooks). Coffeehouse Chapter 11, steakhouse chain closing 40+ locations. Consumer discretionary under pressure.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX, LSG.AX face margin compression. Defensive positioning in staples warranted. Consumer sentiment deteriorating.

sectors.trend: ASX tech shrugs off Wall Street AI sell-off. Nvidia signals AI infrastructure as income asset. AI agents entering payments (Visa/Mastercard). AMD/Intel GCC cooperation. Trump vs tech chiefs on AI speed.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WTC.AX, XRO.AX, SVL.AX) relatively insulated. Global AI capex cycle intact. Monitor for spillover if US sell-off deepens.

defensive_moves.rationale: Mortgage stress, negative equity, and credit tightening raise NPL risk; CBA has strongest capital position

defensive_moves.rationale: Inflation re-acceleration from fuel/food; consumer staples under pressure (coffeehouse, steakhouse closures)

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD downside on geopolitical oil spike
defensive_moves.rationale: Houthis/Iran tensions create AUD volatility; oil spike may initially support AUD but risk-off could reverse

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower over 1–3 months. Fed decision this week is pivotal. Oil spike supports energy but broad risk-off pressures banks and miners. Consumer stress caps upside. Expect ^AXJO volatility 2–3% weekly.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if Fed pivots and oil normalises. Energy transition inflection and critical minerals provide structural tailwinds. Consumer recovery depends on RBA easing and wage growth. Productivity/immigration debate may reshape fiscal policy.
